How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.amu.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 03-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AMU Guest Teacher recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the AMU Guest Teacher recruitment is 03 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Guest Teacher post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Guest Teacher post at Aligarh Muslim University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Rs. 500/-.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee for SC/ST candidates is also Rs. 500/-.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Guest Teacher position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Guest Teacher position is Rs. 1,500 per lecture, with a maximum limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Online.

faq.question: Q7. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Teacher post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's degree with 55% marks in Linguistics/LAMM or a Ph.D. in Linguistics/LAMM with NET/SLET/SET exemption, or a foreign Ph.D. from a top-ranked university.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Guest Teacher role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Teacher role will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article, under the "Official Notification PDF" description.
